The read it does govern: the publish at :942 is d.client.PublishWithin(ctx, item), with ctx derived at :856 from r.Context() under sendRequestBudget (3500 ms, :707). So the resolution can spend 2 x 2 s before the bounded publish begins, which is more than the 3.5 s budget - the consequence the comment states. The old sentence said the role-holder read and the publish 'take the same deadline a send's do', which was true of the publish and asserted of both.
